question: Could you assess the relationship between the poverty rates from the previous year's census data and the percentage of births without maternal morbidity for the years 2016 to 2018? Use only data for births where no maternal morbidity was reported and for each year, use the 5-year census data from the year before to compute the Pearson correlation coefficient
sql:
WITH births AS (
  SELECT 
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as birth_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1) THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as total_with_morbidity_info
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2018 AND Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
  GROUP BY County_of_Residence_FIPS, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year)
),
data_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    CAST(b.no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / CAST(b.total_with_morbidity_info AS FLOAT64) as pct_no_morbidity,
    CAST(c.poverty AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(CAST(c.pop_determined_poverty_status AS FLOAT64), 0) as poverty_rate
  FROM births b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr` c 
    ON LPAD(b.County_of_Residence_FIPS, 5, '0') = c.geo_id
  WHERE b.birth_year = 2016 
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
data_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    CAST(b.no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / CAST(b.total_with_morbidity_info AS FLOAT64) as pct_no_morbidity,
    CAST(c.poverty AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(CAST(c.pop_determined_poverty_status AS FLOAT64), 0) as poverty_rate
  FROM births b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr` c 
    ON LPAD(b.County_of_Residence_FIPS, 5, '0') = c.geo_id
  WHERE b.birth_year = 2017 
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
data_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    CAST(b.no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / CAST(b.total_with_morbidity_info AS FLOAT64) as pct_no_morbidity,
    CAST(c.poverty AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(CAST(c.pop_determined_poverty_status AS FLOAT64), 0) as poverty_rate
  FROM births b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` c 
    ON LPAD(b.County_of_Residence_FIPS, 5, '0') = c.geo_id
  WHERE b.birth_year = 2018 
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 2016 as year, poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity FROM data_2016
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2017 as year, poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity FROM data_2017
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2018 as year, poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity FROM data_2018
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) as sum_x,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_xy,
    SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) as sum_x2,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y2
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  n,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) as pearson_correlation
FROM stats
